mapper.update: UPDATE memory_search_doc SET status='READY',embedding=#{vector}::vector,embedding_model=#{model},embedded_at=#{now},lease_until=NULL WHERE id=#{lease.id} AND status='PROCESSING' AND lease_until=#{lease.until} AND lease_until>#{now}
mapper.select: WITH hits AS ( SELECT d.theme_id,d.theme_week_start,tv.title,tv.intro_image_uri,a.mission_id,mv.title mission_title, d.attempt_id,left(coalesce(ans.plain_text,''),500) answer_excerpt,1.01-(d.embedding <=> CAST(#{vector} AS vector)) score FROM memory_search_doc d JOIN attempt a ON a.id=d.attempt_id JOIN theme_frame f ON f.student_id=d.student_id AND f.theme_id=d.theme_id AND f.theme_week_start=d.theme_week_start JOIN weekly_theme_version tv ON tv.id=f.theme_version_id JOIN mission_version mv ON mv.id=a.mission_version_id JOIN LATERAL (SELECT plain_text FROM answer WHERE attempt_id=a.id ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1) ans ON true WHERE d.student_id=#{studentId} AND a.student_id=d.student_id AND d.theme_week_start<#{before} AND d.status='READY' AND a.context IN ('THEME_DAY','THEME_REVIEW') AND a.completed_at IS NOT NULL AND ans.plain_text ILIKE #{keyword} ESCAPE '!'d.embedding_model=#{model} ), rounds AS ( SELECT theme_id,theme_week_start,max(score) score FROM hits WHERE score>=#{minimum} GROUP BY theme_id,theme_week_start ORDER BY score DESC,theme_week_start DESC,theme_id LIMIT 3 ) SELECT h.* FROM hits h JOIN rounds r USING(theme_id,theme_week_start) WHERE h.score>=#{minimum} ORDER BY r.score DESC,h.theme_week_start DESC,h.theme_id,h.score DESC,h.attempt_id
